response.answer: Top trends in explainable AI for MRI diagnostics include ensemble XAI methods, dataset harmonization, and clinician feedback to improve model transparency and accuracy. Hierarchical occlusion schemes and reproducible pipelines are also crucial for validating AI-driven diagnostic tools.
